note: 51, owns and runs a ranch with employees, former military, three sons. Health is the textbook neglected corner of a life that is otherwise working — 'I never dedicated the time before because I don't think I qualified it as a need' — while at 178 lb and 5'8" doing hard physical work all day he is plainly not deconditioned. He wants strength, mobility and to lean out, not rescue. Income is recorded as a match rather than a miss on his own framing: the constraint was seasonal liquidity, not affordability — 'the amount of money doesn't scare me' and 'if I had to, I'd probably just do it'. Note this is a deliberate departure from the precedent set on the Francisco Vega assessment, where needing instalments was scored as an income miss; here the prospect explicitly separated cash timing from capacity, and flattening the two would lose the distinction. Alongside Vik Singh, one of only two core-ICP fits in this batch.
